videos.title: 574 - Hot take: ontology is where the contract belongs
videos.description:
574 - The hot take: ontology is where the data agent contract layer belongs, not the semantic model and not the lakehouse. It needs a rewrite first, though. Think PBIP for ontologies, not one YAML file.

https://youtu.be/qQ8GfnMReO4

#ontology #microsoftfabric #dataagents #semanticlayer #dataengineering

videos.title: 574 - Two teams, same customer count, different answer
videos.description:
574 - One team filters three things out of customer count. Another team leaves those in and filters something else. Both call it customer count. If you say A and I hear B, the agent has no chance either.

https://youtu.be/qQ8GfnMReO4

#datagovernance #semanticlayer #metrics #aiagents #dataquality

videos.title: 574 - Give your measures a weight of seven
videos.description:
574 - Customer rollup A gets a weight of seven. Rollup B gets a three. That's how the agent knows which source wins when two measures look the same. Weights are a thing in AI, so why not in our metric definitions?

https://youtu.be/qQ8GfnMReO4

#aiagents #datamodeling #metrics #semanticlayer #powerbi

videos.title: 574 - A semantic model today isn't a semantic model
videos.description:
574 - A semantic model today is two things wearing one name: the semantics and the data, welded together. Pull them apart and you need somewhere to put each one. Neither place really exists yet.

https://youtu.be/qQ8GfnMReO4

#semanticmodel #powerbi #microsoftfabric #datamodeling #lakehouse

videos.title: 574 - The lakehouse can't hold a measure
videos.description:
574 - Lakehouse tables go as wide and as tall as you want. They still can't hold a measure or a relationship, which is exactly what a semantic model needs. That gap puts the whole thing in a strange spot.

https://youtu.be/qQ8GfnMReO4

#lakehouse #semanticmodel #microsoftfabric #powerbi #dataengineering

videos.title: 574 - Put every semantic model table in Direct Lake
videos.description:
574 - The ideal setup: every table in every semantic model coming out of the lakehouse, most of it in Direct Lake mode. Update the table and the model has it. Not realistic for every company, but here's why it's worth chasing.

https://youtu.be/qQ8GfnMReO4

#directlake #microsoftfabric #lakehouse #semanticmodel #powerbi

videos.title: 574 - New context folder showed up in your lakehouse
videos.description:
574 - Microsoft showed semantic views at FabCon with no blog to go with it, and a brand new context folder appeared in the lakehouse holding Semantic Views and Semantic System Context. Here's the read on where that's heading.

https://youtu.be/qQ8GfnMReO4

#microsoftfabric #semanticviews #lakehouse #fabcon #powerbi

videos.title: 574 - Is five-year-old data even relevant to you?
videos.description:
574 - Five-year-old numbers from a company a fifth of today's size tell you almost nothing. The volume shifted, and so did the columns people need. Marketing wants different customer attributes than sales does.

https://youtu.be/qQ8GfnMReO4

#dataengineering #datastrategy #analytics #datamodeling #businessintelligence

videos.title: 574 - Don't load every customer into every model
videos.description:
574 - One client has a master customer table so big it can't go in every semantic model. The trick is carrying only the customers that show up in two years of fact data. Enterprise keeps the full table.

https://youtu.be/qQ8GfnMReO4

#powerbi #semanticmodel #datamodeling #dimensionalmodeling #microsoftfabric

items.title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Set invoice limits for time and material billing
items.description: Customers often issue a purchase order that sets how much they'll accept on each invoice for a time and material engagement. Until now, Dynamics 365 Project Operations had no place to record that amount, so project managers and billing teams tracked it in spreadsheets and checked invoices by hand, adding reconciliation work and the risk of disputes. You can now set an invoice amount limit for each billing period on a time and material contract line's invoice schedule: Enter the limit for each pe

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Segmentation of recordings and transcripts in Contact Center
items.description:
Enterprise customers, particularly in regulated industries and large distributed contact center environments operating across multiple business units, geographies, vendors, and service providers, require strict controls to ensure users can access only the recordings and transcripts relevant to their operational scope while maintaining appropriate supervisory and compliance visibility.
This feature enables segmentation of interaction data by organizational boundaries such as Business Units, Teams

items.title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Deprecate transaction origins
items.description: Dynamics 365 Project Operations streamlines transaction processing by replacing separate transaction origin records with direct source document references on transaction records, including journal lines, actuals, and invoice line details. This approach reduces the database operations required to maintain links to originating time entries, expenses, and material usage logs, and enables the phased retirement of transaction origin record creation.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Human Resources: Streamline the preboarding experience
items.description:
Business value
Preboarding gives candidates a clear, consistent way to complete requirements before their first day. HR teams can reduce manual follow-ups, repeated data entry, and delays caused by incomplete information by using a structured process with configured validation and document requirements. A guided experience helps candidates understand what to do next, while HR administrators maintain a repeatable process that supports day-one readiness.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Finance: Merge bank account financial dimensions when generating vouchers from bank reconciliation rules
items.description: When vouchers are generated through bank reconciliation rules, financial dimensions from the selected bank account are merged with the financial dimensions defined on the reconciliation rule. Dimensions specified on the reconciliation rule take precedence, while any dimensions that aren't specified on the rule automatically default from the bank account. This enhancement enables a single voucher-generation rule to be reused across multiple bank accounts, reducing setup and maintenance effort whi

items.title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Release commerce orders from POS to the warehouse
items.description:
Business Value
For trade counter and call center operations, orders often need to reach the warehouse quickly so that picking and fulfillment activities can begin without delay. Without a direct path from Commerce to the warehouse management system, staff must manually intervene on every order, which slows fulfillment and increases the risk of missed or delayed shipments.
This feature removes that bottleneck by automatically releasing routine orders on a scheduled basis, eliminating repetitive m

items.title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Improve order capture workflows in Store Commerce
items.description:
Business value
Every friction point in order capture adds time to each transaction and increases the risk of downstream errors. Context that has no field is lost. A customer order converts to a cash-and-carry sale when all lines are marked as carryout, which removes flexibility that trade counter staff depend on. Standing values such as a customer's purchase order number are retyped on every transaction. This release is designed to address those friction points.

Store associates print labels in the store, either on demand or from a label print request sent by Commerce headquarters when prices or promotions change. Headquarters is where administrators configure label formats and the printers available to each store, and where headquarters users create and release those requests. items.title: Microsoft 365: Frontier expands to public previews in Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, and SharePoint
items.description: Frontier is expanding to bring eligible public preview features across Microsoft 365 into one program. Users enrolled in Frontier can get eligible previews for new Outlook for Windows, OneDrive, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, and Copilot, managed through a single admin-controlled enrollment experience. Frontier enrollment is optional and separate from Standard and Deferred release preferences for generally available features. Existing Frontier users do not need to re-enroll.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Use bullseye routing with user groups to orchestrate conversations
items.description:
Bullseye routing with user groups enables a tiered assignment strategy that automatically expands the pool of eligible representatives as conversation wait time increases. Rather than assigning from a fixed pool or waiting for overflow rules to trigger, this approach progressively widens availability in concentric rings—starting with the best-fit representatives and expanding outward as needed.
Administrators configure this scenario by associating user groups with a queue and defining wait time

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): App Blocks

items.title: Excel: Edit with Copilot in Excel on iPhone
items.description: Edit with Copilot makes it easier to edit and transform your Excel workbooks on your phone using natural language. Copilot can continue working on your task even when you move away from the app, so you can come back when the work is ready. Chat mode also remains available when you want to ask questions and get insights without making changes to your workbook.

items.description:
Overflow for direct inward dialing leverages conversation orchestration to detect key direct inward dialing-related events—such as the representative being busy, offline, rejecting the call, or failing to answer—and apply administrator-defined fallback actions.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Unified routing - Orchestrate conversation distribution with natural language playbooks
items.description: Conversation orchestration in Dynamics 365 Contact Center keeps every conversation actively managed throughout its lifecycle, from initiation through resolution. items.title: Microsoft 365 app: Inventory - Update Repair
items.description: Update Repair helps admins identify Windows devices with Microsoft 365 Apps that are out of date or experiencing update issues. In the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center, admins can review device status and recommended actions, remotely start Online Repair for eligible devices, and follow manual remediation guidance for devices that need attention. Repair reinstalls Microsoft 365 Apps using the latest available build for the device’s configured update channel.

Queue transitions to out-of-operating hours: The system continuously monitors active conversations that entered a queue before closing time. When the previous or preferred expert is unavailable, assignments seamlessly fall back to the next best qualified expert, preserving service levels and reliability. items.title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator's enhanced protection skill can alert you to potential scams
items.description: Facilitator can help you spot suspected attempts by people outside your organization to trick you into sharing sensitive information during a meeting. When Facilitator is in your meeting, its Protection skill uses AI to check the meeting transcript for signs of possible social engineering. If it detects a suspected attempt, you'll see a warning in the meeting, with options to end or to temporarily restrict information sharing.

items.title: OneDrive: Prompt gallery for Copilot
items.description:
Discover easier ways to use Copilot in OneDrive
The new Prompt Gallery offers ready-to-use prompts for common file tasks, helping you get started quickly, discover what Copilot can do, and customize prompts to fit your needs.
Access the Prompt Gallery from:
The Copilot button in the bottom-right corner of OneDrive
The + button in the Copilot chat pane
Select Open Prompt Gallery to explore prompts across categories such as Create, Analyze, Find, and Collaborate.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Events in Meet app in Teams in GCC High and DoD
items.description: Users can now use the Teams Meet app to discover events across their organization, track what important events are upcoming, and plan and organize their own professional events. With this release, Meet app will be renamed to Events app.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention-Expanded inline protection for unmanaged apps in Edge for Business
items.description: Microsoft Purview collection and data loss prevention (DLP) policies will support browser inline protection for a significantly broader set of unmanaged generative AI apps in Edge for Business. Admins can use existing Purview policy experiences to detect and protect sensitive data shared through supported browser activities, helping extend consistent data security controls across more destinations.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft Cowork
items.description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) is expanding to Microsoft Cowork, enabling data security admins to use a single policy across Microsoft 365 Copilot and Cowork. The integration helps protect sensitive AI interactions by preventing the use of labeled knowledge sources, blocking prompts that contain supported sensitive information types, and restricting sensitive prompts from being sent to Bing for web search.

items.title: Planner: AI-generated Status Reports in Planner Agent
items.description: AI-powered Status Report in Planner Agent turns your plan data into a polished, stakeholder-ready update in minutes. Just ask Planner Agent for a status report and it pulls your task data and transforms it into a clear narrative covering overall status, progress, risks, and what's next. You can easily customize the report to your needs by specifying the audience, tone, length, and sections you want.

items.title: Planner: Planner Agent chat in Basic Plans
items.description: Introducing built-in Planner Agent chat with natural language Q&A, smart task discovery, and in-plan task management.

items.title: Planner: Local Custom Fields/Columns
items.description: Custom Fields let you tailor your plans to match the way your team works. Add Text, Number, Date, Yes/No, and Choice fields to capture the information that matters most. View and update custom fields across Board, Grid, and Task details, with support for sorting, filtering, grouping, and bulk editing to keep your work organized and easy to manage.

items.title: OneNote: Multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks (Windows)
items.description: Capture on Windows helps you bring conversations and ideas from meetings, brainstorming sessions, and everyday work into Copilot Notebooks. Capture audio, images, and notes in one experience, then let Copilot turn them into structured notes with key insights, decisions, and action items, in a Copilot Notebook of your choice

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Protect sensitive data over FTP and SFTP with Endpoint DLP
items.description: Endpoint DLP support for FTP and SFTP enables organizations to monitor and protect sensitive data transferred from managed endpoints using FTP and SFTP, helping prevent unauthorized data exfiltration while maintaining visibility and control.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Multiple Voice Styles in M365 Copilot voice chats
items.description: Users can select from multiple voice style options for their voice experience in M365 Copilot.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention to restrict processing external emails in Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat
items.description: We are expanding Microsoft Purview DLP for Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat to safeguard risks from external emails. This real-time control helps organizations mitigate data risks by preventing Microsoft 365 Copilot and Chat from processing emails from senders external to your organization.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Admins can govern and manage federated copilot connectors in Microsoft 365 admin center
items.description: Admins can govern and manage federated copilot connectors in Microsoft 365 admin center. #copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: Outlook: Enriching profile cards with custom, organization-specific properties
items.description: Customers can now customize their M365 profile cards by adding custom properties unique to their organization. These properties can be sourced from external systems like HR platforms, enriching user profiles with relevant organizational details. Tenant admins can configure these properties with a display name and icon, which will appear in the Contact Information section of the profile cards.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Streamlined Authentication process with OAuth for Connector Admins
items.description: Effortless authentication, unified through OAuth — empowering Connector Admins to connect in just a few clicks. #copilotcontrolsystem

Drive Copilot chat engagement for 3P content via deep citations, inline citations, side by side preview experiences.

Multi-Criteria Site Search
Copilot can help you find sites using multiple conditions at once.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Realtime voice interactions in Word and PowerPoint
items.description: Use your voice to talk with Copilot, interact in-real time, and understand the content within your document or presentation. Updated September 9, 2026: We will be re-releasing this feature with updates in October. Thank you for your patience.

items.title: OneNote: Summary and Q&A in OneNote Mobile with Copilot (Iphone)
items.description: With this new Summary feature in OneNote mobile, you can create a short and fluent summary of your longer pages which will help to consume relevant information faster. With the Question and Answer at your fingertips, you can get real-time answers to your queries directly within your notes, enhancing your ability to access and utilize information quickly and effectively. items.title: Microsoft Viva: Import HRIS data in Viva Glint from Microsoft Admin Center
items.description: Customers will be able to use various connectors to HRIS tools to import HRIS data into Viva Glint from Microsoft Admin Center.

items.title: OneDrive: Command-line tool for the OneDrive sync app
items.description: A new command-line tool, odcli, lets OneDrive users, IT admins and support engineers check and manage the OneDrive sync app from the command line. Commands cover sync status, accounts, configuration, policies, and managing the sync app. JSON output lets scripts, management tools and AI agents automate these tasks.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Invoice usability enhancements
items.description:
When billing teams review an invoice, they need to see where it stands, which transactions it includes, and what's still waiting to be billed. When that information is spread across tabs and long lists, reviews take longer and it's easier to miss a transaction.
This update makes invoices easier to review:
Timeline on the summary. The invoice summary includes a timeline [Confirm what it shows, such as status history from draft to posted], so you can see where the invoice stands without leaving th

items.title: Dynamics 365 Finance: Table edit with Microsoft Power BI filters and slicers
items.description: The table edit visual now responds to filters and slicers applied within the Microsoft Power BI report. When users filter the report using a slicer or other supported report filtering experience, the table edit visual reflects that filter context and displays the relevant dimension records.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Finance: Faster cube data loading with optimized dataflows
items.description:
Business performance planning introduces an optimized dataflow capability designed to improve the performance of loading data into planning cubes.
The optimized dataflow improves how data is processed and loaded into the cube, reducing the time required to populate planning models, particularly when working with larger datasets.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Finance: Faster cube data loading with optimized dataflows
items.description:
The Matrix visual now provides clearer control over how zero and blank values are handled during planning.
Users can explicitly save 0 as a planning value, preserving the underlying record with a value of zero. Users can also delete an existing planning record by clearing the cell and saving the blank value.
This behavior is supported when editing both leaf-level and parent-level cells, providing a consistent experience when users enter values directly or make adjustments at an aggregated level

items.title: Work IQ: Memory capabilities expand to agents
items.description: A new Work IQ MCP path, /memory/me/coreMemories, gives authorized agents access to a user’s memory profile. This profile enables agents to provide more personalized and relevant assistance. At launch, it includes Custom Instructions, Saved Memories, relevant work account data, and memories derived from chat history. The memory profile will continue to evolve and improve over time.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Insights and Copilot Analytics in GCC and GCC High
items.description:
We are expanding the availability of Viva Insights and Copilot Analytics capabilities in Microsoft 365 Government Community Cloud (GCC, or GCC-M) and GCC High (GCC-H). Availability differs for a small number of capabilities by cloud, as noted below.

items.title: Microsoft 365 Copilot (Microsoft 365): Accounting skills
items.description:
Streamline corporate accounting work
New accounting capabilities in Excel and Cowork help accountants spend less time on repetitive, manual tasks in the places they already work, including:
•	Reconcile accounts with confidence: Compare balances and transactions, identify discrepancies, and prepare reconciling items for review.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Specify contacts on orders and quotations in POS
items.description:
In B2B commerce, the company is the customer of record, but the individuals who place orders, make deposits, and collect goods can vary from transaction to transaction. Without a way to identify these individuals, retailers have limited visibility into who performed specific actions. This can create accountability gaps and make it more difficult to resolve disputes or meet compliance requirements.
This feature addresses that challenge by making contacts a first-class part of the Store Commerce t

items.title: Microsoft 365: [Education] Microsoft Learning Zone - Improve Lesson Insights
items.description:
See where your class is struggling and which students need support, with lesson-level results for every student. Aggregated responses show the mistakes many students made in a lesson. You can then open each student's answers to plan targeted follow-up.
#education

items.title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Unified Pricing Management - Attribute-based margin thresholds and tiers for approvals and reporting
items.description:
Pricing managers can set margin controls that match how the business actually sells, instead of one threshold for everything. Each product, channel and customer gets the right margin guardrail.
With this feature, pricing managers can define margin thresholds based on price attributes such as product category, product attributes, channel and customer group. Each threshold can include three margin tiers: floor, target and ceiling. The tiers drive approvals for price overrides and manual discounts

items.title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Unified Pricing Management - Set prices per price unit for low-value items
items.description:
Businesses that sell small, low-value items, such as fasteners, electronic components or packaging, can maintain prices more easily and accurately, without rounding problems from tiny per-unit prices.
With this feature, Unified Pricing Management supports price units, so you can set a price per batch of units instead of per single unit. For example, you can price an item per 100 or 1,000 units. Unified Pricing Management then calculates the correct line amount from the order quantity.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Unified Pricing Management - Require manager approval for price overrides and manual discounts that exceed margin limits
items.description:
Retailers can protect their profitability without slowing down store operations. Sales associates can still adjust prices to close a sale. Any change that would push an item below the allowed margin goes to a manager for review, so discounting decisions stay controlled and consistent.
With this feature, Unified Pricing Management checks every price override and manual discount against margin thresholds set in the pricing parameters. If a change would exceed the allowed limit, Store Commerce (POS

items.title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Unified Pricing Management - View item margins on carts and orders in POS and APIs
items.description: Store associates and other selling channels can now see margins while they sell. This helps them make better pricing decisions and avoid unprofitable discounts or price overrides, so pricing stays consistent across channels.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Show ATP and transfer lead time in Dynamics 365 Commerce inventory lookup
items.description:
Store and trade-counter associates often need to source items from another store or warehouse and tell the customer when the item will arrive. This feature brings available-to-promise (ATP) data from Inventory Visibility together with transfer lead times in Store Commerce, so associates can choose the best location and set accurate delivery dates. This feature includes:

ATP and estimated arrival in inventory lookup: View ATP quantities and dates across locations, plus the estimated arrival date

items.title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Tap to Pay on Android using Adyen connector
items.description:
Business Value
Tap to Pay on Android empowers sales associates with mobility, enabling them to accept payments directly on over-the-counter Android devices without relying on fixed terminals. This reduces the need for costly payment hardware, streamlines checkout experiences, and enhances customer engagement by allowing transactions anywhere in the store.
Feature Details
This feature enables Tap to Pay on Android devices running the Store Commerce App via the Adyen payment connector. As a prereq

items.description: Let tenants trim file-version bloat created by retention, without breaking compliance promises. SharePoint/compliance admins at large, regulated enterprises must cap and reclaim storage consumed by retained file versions, while keeping legal-hold and records promises intact. items.description:
Help ensure expense receipts include required company VAT information by applying your organization’s receipt validation rules. Expense Agent can check submitted receipts for a valid company VAT number (Tax ID) when your configured rules require one, and flag receipts for review or prevent them from moving forward based on your policies.
Benefits

•	Automatically validate required VAT information during expense proce

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Education] Create multi-week unit plans with Teach
items.description:
Educators can use Teach in Microsoft 365 Copilot to create structured unit plans that span multiple lessons or weeks. They can customize the plan components to organize connected lesson plans and quizzes across a unit.
#education

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Pinch to zoom in on shared screens
items.description: Get a closer look at shared content in Teams calls and meetings with pinch-to-zoom using your touchpad. Quickly zoom in to make small text and detailed visuals easier to see, then zoom back out for the full view. Existing zoom controls remain available.

items.title: Outlook: Inline chat for email drafting
items.description: Instead of opening Copilot Chat every time you want to use Copilot to draft a message, this change introduces an inline chat component that streamlines the process and lets you interact with Copilot without opening the sidebar.

items.title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Data Quality Report for Profile Data
items.description: Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Services is introducing a new data quality report that helps administrators assess the coverage and health of people data used across Microsoft 365 experiences. High-quality people data enables users to more effectively discover and learn about colleagues through experiences such as the People Card, Org Explorer, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and Microsoft 365 Cowork. The new report provides organizational data administrators, People Administrators, and AI Administrato

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Graph API Support for Archive Mailboxes
items.description: Access to Archive mailboxes (Main + Auxiliary) through Microsoft Graph. The goal is to give users a single, seamless Archive view, even though Archive data may physically reside across multiple auxiliary mailboxes with EWS Graph APIs getting deprecated by OCT 2026.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Use MCP-compliant tools in agent workflows
items.description: Integrate proprietary systems, dynamic knowledge sources, and custom actions into your agentic workflows with MCP support, accelerating extensibility while preserving workflow reliability. This integration improves reuse across agents and workflows, reduces duplication of integrations, and embraces an emerging open and extensible agent ecosystem.

items.title: SharePoint: Admin Center - Data Access Governance - Permission report for a given group
items.description: A single group with broad membership or a special group for vendors etc. - can expose sensitive content to unintended recipients. With this new report, SharePoint admins can now see every site a group can access and the extent of that access.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Improved organization for muted and meeting chats
items.description: Microsoft Teams automatically organizes your chats with new built in sections that help reduce clutter and keep conversations easy to find. Muted chats (on by default) are grouped together in a dedicated area, while meeting chats (off by default) can be collected into a single section for quick access. You’re always in control, as each section can be turned on or off based on your preferences. The new Meeting chats section will replace the Meeting chats filter, that was previously available at t

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Users can create agents scoped on Custom connector containers
items.description:
Makers can now scope their data in their agent created on custom connector data at a particular container.
These containers will be defined during creation/updating of the custom connector.
